cheek.best_supported_hypothesis: Authored/custom-normal behavior at the repaired contact band is a leading cause: cap/repainted-original face means strongly diverge from geometric normals while untouched originals do not.
cheek.confirmed: Visible cluster survives coat removal and constant-gray material but is essentially absent under basecolor emission. It is not caused solely by fringe, basecolor or normal-map textures.
cheek.remaining_ambiguity: Geometry folds/overlap and winding can also create or interact with these mismatches. Gray retains custom normals and shadows; normal angles alone do not prove correct geometry or which specific visible pixel is affected.

fringe.confirmed: Adds fine silhouette texture but neither contact defect disappears when it is hidden.
fringe.decision: Do not select fur-density changes as the repair for these defects.

shoulder.best_supported_hypothesis: The existing body source-color/UV route contributes. All42 sparse green-sampling candidate faces are unchanged original primitive5, so the green is not confined to authored cap UV repainting.
shoulder.confirmed: Green and pale flecks persist with coat hidden and in basecolor emission.
shoulder.remaining_ambiguity: Seven samples per candidate face do not identify the exact displayed fleck. The preserved companion materials remain lit; actual visible face/material hits are needed before a color/UV correction.

cpu_job_limit.scope: Numeric values above come from complete saved checkpoint JSON only. The whole CPU study did not finish and has no implicit pass.

limits: One720px view at dance_flight1.36s; no other-view/continuous-motion/physical accuracy claim.
No exact-pixel material or topology attribution was completed by this reviewer.
Conspicuous cheek and shoulder defects remain; Muse parity and finished avatar acceptance are not established.

minimum_next_diagnostic.conditional_repair_direction: Only after those hits agree, restrict normal-continuity correction to proven affected provenance classes and retain original normals on unaffected/repainted original surfaces where valid. Do not globally flatten normals or repaint the panda from these screenshots.
measure: For a few visible cheek-defect pixels and adjacent controls, record exact face/origin, geometric and interpolated custom normals, facing and closest depth layers.
For visible shoulder green/pale pixels, record exact face/material and UV0 color sample; distinguish unchanged original, repainted original, closure and companion surfaces.
minimum_next_diagnostic.scope: Reuse parent-owned sparse CPU pixel-hit attribution, not a new full render study.
